audience: agents and humans installing multi-agent hotload into a working repo
operators keeping agent launchers on a personal machine
maintainers of the ACS module registry
problem: Agent setups usually live in one chat session: launchers, role rosters, lease rules, and env wiring. When that session ends, the next reader inherits nothing they can trust from the repository alone.
solution: ACS registers versioned setup modules and ships multi-agent-hotload as the install surface that wires continuity helpers + FULL CGM 0.5.5 + coordination runtime without vendoring those helpers.
mechanism: registry.json + POLICY.md define harness/setup/version layout and SoT vs deploy mirrors
multi-agent-hotload HOTLOAD.md load order: ACS policy then continuity helpers then this runtime
hotload_check validates assignment pins and required helper checkouts on the working repo

evidence.claim: ACS registry indexes versioned modules with temporal metadata.
evidence.supports: registry.json on origin/main lists active modules with paths, versions, and temporal fields.
evidence.limits: Index accuracy depends on PR discipline; registry is not a runtime enforcer.

evidence.claim: InferHub LiteLLM Claude Code launcher is sealed at 0.2.0 with env-name-only secrets.
evidence.supports: Module tree and registry entry exist on origin/main; launchers reference env var names only.
evidence.limits: Needs local LiteLLM and a gitignored runtime .env; does not prove every Desktop mirror is in sync.

evidence.claim: Multi-agent hotload pack shipped via merged PR #12 with lease/queue/watchdog rules.
evidence.supports: Pack docs, schema, hotload_check, and tests landed on origin/main through PR #12.
evidence.limits: Does not prove every adopter has run hotload_check; open follow-on gates stay planned.

evidence.claim: ACS is source of truth; Desktop paths are deploy mirrors; secrets never enter git.
evidence.supports: POLICY.md states SoT vs mirrors, PR-only main, and no-secrets rules.
evidence.limits: Policy text, not a runtime enforcer of Desktop sync or secret scanning.

evidence.claim: External research gate for hotload adopters is proposed (PR #14).
evidence.supports: Open PR #14 proposes a binding external research gate; not merged.
evidence.limits: Still under review; do not treat as shipped behavior on main.

evidence.claim: JEV architecture knowledge pack is proposed (PR #16).
evidence.supports: Open PR #16 proposes a knowledge pack module; not merged.
evidence.limits: Still under review; not available on origin/main.

evidence.claim: Optional jev-gate-pin stub is proposed (PR #18 / issue #17).
evidence.supports: Open PR #18 (Refs #17) proposes an optional jev-gate-pin stub with Fish fixtures; not merged.
evidence.limits: Still under review; not part of shipped registry modules on main.
